free_tier.stated: USD 1 trial credit for new accounts; about 500 live Google SERPs at USD 0.002, or more in the Standard queue at USD 0.0006 a SERP
free_tier.notes: Paid use needs a minimum top-up of USD 50, taken by card, PayPal or Amazon Pay; the balance does not expire. A free Sandbox returns sample responses without spending credit.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a SERP of up to 10 organic results

retention.stated: one-time trial credit; topped-up balances do not expire

interface_detail: POST https://api.dataforseo.com/v3/serp/google/organic/live/advanced with HTTP Basic auth (login email and API password); Standard and Priority queues use separate task_post and task_get calls
tooling: plain HTTP with Basic auth; a Playground, an MCP route and templates for n8n, Postman and Google Sheets in the dashboard
chaining: A paid Google SERP at USD 0.60 per 1,000 in the Standard queue once past the USD 50 minimum top-up; the USD 1 trial only tests it

limits.value: USD 1 one-time trial; USD 0.0006 per SERP in the Standard queue, USD 0.0012 Priority, USD 0.002 Live; USD 50 minimum top-up
10,000 requests a minute general rate limit; each POST carries up to 100 tasks

binding_note: the USD 1 trial is spent long before the 10,000-a-minute rate limit is reached

identity_cost.detail: a personal-email address takes a phone number at signup, and the phone fields of the signup form and of the dashboard's phone verification leave out Russia, Belarus, Iran and Cuba (ru, by, ir, cu); a business-email address takes no phone number, and the form gives a company-domain address as the business example and gmail.com, outlook.com, yahoo.com and similar as personal; the dashboard says adding funds bypasses phone verification; unverified: whether the server accepts a given custom domain as business, and whether it refuses numbers of other countries

reliability_note: a keyless call answered 401 with status_code 40100; no throttle or ban event recorded
